Lets those surfaces stay bright at a sky-safe (low) sun brightness instead of over-darkening when cl_avfx_sun_lighting is on (PO Bugs/66). 1 = previous behavior, 5 = default, up to 20. No effect when cl_avfx_sun_lighting is off.
cl_avfx_sun_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..2 / 0=manual 1=cycle 2=real-clockSun position time mode. 0 = manual — use cl_avfx_sun_azimuth / cl_avfx_sun_elevation cvars verbatim (good for screenshots and tests). 1 = day cycle — 24h day passes in cl_avfx_sun_day_length minutes; cl_avfx_sun_time sets the starting hour. 2 = real local clock — sun position follows system time-of-day. Codex Q6 binding.
cl_avfx_sun_sizedefault 0.55 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Sun disk angular size multiplier. 0.55 (default) gives a visible tuned disk with glow; up to 5.0 for cinematic exaggerated sun; 0.1 = tiny pinpoint. Now ALSO scales sun scene lighting: a normalized, bounded area factor (size/0.55)^2 clamped to [0.05, 4.0], equal to 1.0 at the default size so the accepted default look is unchanged. A bigger sun lights world/snow/water/entities/sky more; a smaller sun dims them. The visible disk geometry and brightness are unchanged (scene illumination only, gated by cl_avfx_sun_lighting).
cl_avfx_sun_timedefault 8.75 / range 0.0..24.0 / step 0.25Hour of day 0..24 used by Day Cycle mode as the starting hour. Also used as a static value when mode = Manual but the user wants to specify by time-of-day rather than azimuth/elevation. 12 = noon (sun near peak elevation in default model).
cl_avfx_sun_world_lightdefault 2.60 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Sun contribution to world / level surfaces. 2.60 (default) = strong tuned sunlight on outdoor surfaces; 0 = no world tint from sun; up to 3.0 for cinematic bright daylight. Applied as a fragment-shader multiply after lightmap contribution and before fog. Gated by cl_avfx_sun_indoor_leak when the player is in a closed space.
cl_avfx_surface_grass0=off (default) / 1=onEnable instanced grass over eligible flat and gently sloped static world surfaces. Requires the Surface Objects master (cl_avfx_surface_objects) to be on as well. Off by default; purely a client-side visual with no effect on gameplay, collision or the server.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_antialiasingdefault 3 / 0=off / 1=2x 2=3x 3=4x 4=5x 5=6x 6=7x 7=8xGrass geometry antialiasing quality. 0 uses one raster sample. Levels 1..7 accumulate 2..8 fixed sub-pixel samples of the original vertical blade geometry inside each frame. No level replaces distant blades with flat coverage. Default 3 = 4x.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_cell_sizedefault 128 / range 4..512 / step 4 / wuWorld-space size of a grass placement cell in world units. Smaller cells give finer placement granularity and more even coverage; larger cells are cheaper to manage. Changing this rebuilds the grass cell grid — it is a topology setting rather than a live cosmetic tweak.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_bdefault 0.18 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, blue channel in linear space. See cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_r for how the three channels combine. Raising blue cools the tint toward teal; 0.18 (default) keeps a warm natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_gdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, green channel in linear space. See cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_r for how the three channels combine. 0.55 (default) is the dominant channel of the natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_rdefault 0.30 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, red channel in linear space. Combined with the green and blue channels it sets the overall blade tint before per-blade colour variation. 0.30 (default) with G=0.55 / B=0.18 gives a natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Per-blade random spread of colour around the base grass colour. 0 paints every blade the exact base colour; 1.0 gives the widest natural mottling of lighter and darker blades. 0.35 (default) is a natural-looking variation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0.05..20.0 / step 0.05Blade density multiplier applied on top of the quality profile. Higher values grow more blades per grass cell for a lusher lawn; lower values thin it out. 1.0 (default) keeps the density chosen by the quality tier.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_distancedefault 1400 / range 128..8192 / step 32 / wuGrass draw distance in world units, measured before the per-quality distance multiplier is applied. Grass cells farther than this from the camera are culled. Larger values show grass further away at higher cost; 1400 (default) is a balanced outdoor value.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_heightdefault 22 / range 1..128 / step 1 / wuBase grass blade height in world units. 22 (default) is an ankle-to-shin height that reads well on most maps; lower values give a mown lawn, higher values give tall meadow grass. Per-blade random variation is added on top via cl_avfx_surface_grass_height_variation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_height_variationdefault 0.45 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Per-blade random spread of blade height around the base height. 0 makes every blade exactly the base height for a uniform trimmed look; 1.0 gives the widest natural mix of short and tall blades. 0.45 (default) is a natural-looking spread.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_maxdefault 24 / range 1..64 / step 1Maximum number of actors that can influence the grass in a single frame. Actors beyond this count do not bend grass that frame; the nearest actors are prioritised. The effective limit is also capped by the quality profile. 24 (default) covers busy scenes.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_monsters0=off / 1=on (default)Nearby grounded monsters part the grass they walk through. Active in local single-player and DM-training only — never during demo playback or remote multiplayer. On by default; requires the interaction master to be on.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_player0=off / 1=on (default)Local player parts nearby grass as they move through it. Enabled by default and allowed both in local play and in permitted multiplayer AVFX modes. Requires the interaction master (cl_avfx_surface_grass_interaction) to be on.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_players0=off (default) / 1=onVisible other player models part nearby grass. This is a local visual only and is off by default; it is forced off under the multiplayer competitive limit. It uses only client entities visible in the current frame, so grass never reacts to players hidden behind walls.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_radiusdefault 42 / range 8..192 / step 2 / wuRadius around each actor, in world units, inside which grass bends away from them. Larger values clear a wider path through the grass; 42 (default) roughly matches a player's body footprint.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_recoverydefault 1.5 / range 0.05..10 / step 0.05 / secRecovery time constant, in seconds, for grass springing back upright after an actor moves away. Lower values snap back almost instantly; 1.5 (default) is a soft natural settle; up to 10 leaves a long-lasting trampled trail behind moving actors.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_strengthdefault 0.70 / range 0..2 / step 0.05How strongly actors bend the grass they are near. 0 leaves grass upright even inside the interaction radius; 0.70 (default) gives a clear natural push; up to 2.0 flattens blades hard around the actor.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interaction0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for grass bending and parting around actors. When on (default), moving actors push nearby blades aside and the blades spring back afterwards. When off, grass ignores all actors and only the wind model animates it. The per-source sub-toggles below have no effect while this master is off.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestialdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onMakes grass follow the live AVFX sun/moon/cloud-transmittance state. Uses grass-specific strength, floor and night tint rather than snow tuning.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_min_brightnessdefault 0.04 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Celestial brightness floor at a dark or moonless night. This is applied before local lights brighten individual fragments.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_night_tintdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Amount of muted cool-green tint applied as sun/moon illumination approaches darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_strengthdefault 1.20 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Strength of sun and moon illumination on grass after cloud attenuation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamicdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables engine dynamic lights on grass: blaster bolts, muzzle flashes, rockets, explosions and similar gameplay sources.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamic_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of dynamic-light colour transferred to grass (red blaster, green BFG, orange explosion, etc.).
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamic_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of grass to engine dynamic lights.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissivedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables the same AVFX map-emissive and spawn/teleporter-marker source families used by snow surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissive_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of emissive-source colour transferred to grass.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissive_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of grass to AVFX emissive source families.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_flashlightdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables per-fragment grass response to the actual AVFX player flashlight cone.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_flashlight_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass brightness response to the flashlight cone; flashlight colour is preserved.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_lightningdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables grass response to the shared bounded lightning-local pool, including meteor-impact illumination registered in that pool.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_lightning_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass response strength for local lightning strikes and meteor-impact lights.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_local_liftdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Common response multiplier for flashlight, lightning/meteor, dynamic and emissive local sources. It controls how strongly those sources restore visible daytime grass in darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_min_brightnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Absolute static-light floor before celestial/local lighting. Low values keep unlit night grass dark; this is not an emissive term.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_static_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Multiplier for the per-cell cached BSP/static light sampled when the grass inventory is built.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_lightingdefault 1 / 0=legacy static only / 1=responsive lightingMaster for responsive grass lighting. 1 uses cached BSP light plus live sun/moon, flashlight, lightning/meteor, engine dynamic and AVFX emissive sources. 0 restores the previous static-only grass shading.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_lod0=off / 1=on (default)Distance level-of-detail. 1 (default) thins and fades distant grass to save cost as it recedes. 0 disables distance thinning so far grass stays at full density — Ultra quality with LOD off is the no-compromise visual reference. The hard draw distance, PVS/frustum culling and the instance cap always stay active regardless of this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_max_instancesdefault 24000 / range 1024..8000000Hard cap on actual rendered grass cards per frame. Ultra permits up to 8,000,000 blades. Card count per placement is determined only by quality and density and never changes with FOV or zoom. Visible placement cells receive coverage first; a deliberately lower cap samples the whole view evenly instead of cutting away complete distant regions.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_outdoor_only0=off / 1=on (default)When on (default), grass grows only on cells that are open to the sky, giving natural outdoor lawns. When off, grass is allowed on every eligible AVFX floor including enclosed indoor rooms. This is a topology setting — changing it re-evaluates surface eligibility.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_qualitydefault 1 / 0=Performance 1=Balanced 2=High 3=UltraGrass quality profile. 0 = Performance, 1 = Balanced (default), 2 = High, 3 = Ultra. Higher tiers grow denser grass with a richer blade mesh, extend the draw distance, and raise the interaction budget — at higher CPU and GPU cost. Ultra is the visual reference tier.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_slope_maxdefault 65 / range 0..75 / step 1 / degMaximum surface slope, in degrees, that is allowed to grow grass. 0 restricts grass to perfectly flat floors; values up to 75 degrees let grass climb steep ramps and banks. This is a topology setting — changing it re-evaluates which surfaces qualify.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_widthdefault 3.0 / range 0.25..16 / step 0.25 / wuGrass blade width in world units. 3.0 (default) is a balanced blade thickness; narrower blades look wispy and fine, wider blades read as broad-leaf grass and fill coverage with fewer instances.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for grass wind sway. When on (default), blades bend and ripple under the wind model. This works independently of any weather preset, so grass can sway with weather turned off. Turn it off for perfectly still grass.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_angledefault 0 / range 0..359 / step 1 / degWind direction in degrees, controlling which way the grass leans. 0 (default) is the reference direction; the value sweeps a full circle so you can align the sway with a map's prevailing wind or its skybox.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..8 / step 0.1Wind oscillation rate — how quickly the sway cycles back and forth. 0 freezes the sway at a static bend; 1.0 (default) is a natural pace; up to 8.0 gives a fast, nervous flutter.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_strengthdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Wind sway strength — how far the blade tips bend away from vertical. 0 holds blades upright even with wind on; 0.55 (default) is a gentle natural breeze; up to 2.0 drives a strong storm-blown bend.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_turbulencedefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05High-frequency turbulence layered on top of the base sway, breaking up the uniform motion with small chaotic flutters. 0 gives a clean single-frequency sway; 1.0 is the most turbulent. 0.35 (default) is natural. The effect is automatically reduced on lower quality tiers.
cl_avfx_surface_materials0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX Surface Materials — optional compatible material and wildlife layers over eligible static-world walls and floors that preserve the map's original texture and lighting. Off by default; client-only, with no gameplay, collision or server effect. Effective only when cl_avfx is also on.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brickdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onBrick family master: irregular masonry with real bump and parallax relief coating eligible static world walls and floors. The original BSP texture and lightmap stay underneath according to coverage and blend; map geometry, collision and gameplay never change. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_alphadefault 0.78 / range 0.00..1.00Overall blend of the masonry into the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: the family stops sampling entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_chippingdefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Amount of broken corners and face fragments. A chip removes material: it changes the height and the material response, not merely the tint.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_color_variationdefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Restrained material variation between individual bricks. It is stable per brick and never turns the wall into a multicolour pattern; it does not alter blend or coverage.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coveragedefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00How much of the eligible surface is coated. At 1 the whole surface is masonry; below 1 broad irregular islands of the original texture stay exposed. It is a macro mask evaluated before any relief work, never random deletion of individual bricks.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coverage_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the coated-area boundary only. It never changes brick or joint width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onCoat eligible floors and gentle slopes. Independent of the wall lane, and floors ignore the wall band controls entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_geometrydefault 0 / range 0.00..1.00Real geometric brick relief on tessellated world surfaces. Shading relief (bump and parallax) can never change a silhouette; this moves vertices, so bricks physically stand out of the wall and the edge of a wall stops being a straight line. It requires hardware tessellation and grows only outward from the authored surface, never behind it; collision is not affected. 0 is off and does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_irregularitydefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded stable variation of course drift, per-brick length and joint edges. It is deterministic in the world: it never depends on time, camera or quality.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_depthdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00How deeply the joint is recessed below the brick faces, within the overall relief. Independent of joint width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_widthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Width of the mortar joint between bricks. Independent of joint depth.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_reliefdefault 0.60 / range 0.00..1.00Overall strength of the visual bump and parallax relief: height, tangent normal response and parallax scale together. Faces stand proud of the joints and chips recess as the view angle changes. This is shading and UV offset only — no map geometry, collision, silhouette or depth is touched. Exactly 0 takes the cheap non-relief path and reports zero parallax steps.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Physical size of a brick and its course. Small = fine masonry; large = massive blocks. It does not change which world region selects which profile.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_gdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto / 1..6 fixed profileMasonry appearance. 0 = Auto: broad stable world regions choose the profile and at most two neighbouring profiles meet in a soft boundary, blended into ONE course grid rather than two overlaid grids. 1 clean masonry; 2 aged uneven; 3 exposed under plaster; 4 dark industrial; 5 pale masonry; 6 damp chipped relief. Profiles differ in brick size, bond, joint width and depth, irregularity and relief calibration, not only in colour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_distributiondefault 0 / 0=uniform, 1=bottom-up bandHow the masonry is spread over a wall. 0 = uniform over the whole surface. 1 = a bottom-up band, as if the wall is faced from its base. Floors are unaffected by this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_fadedefault 0.18 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the band boundary. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_heightdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00How far the coated band reaches up the wall. Ignored when the distribution is uniform and on floors.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onCoat eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_coverings_orderdefault 0 / 0=Floor layer below Wall layer, 1=Wall layer below Floor layerWhich of the two Surface Coverings layers lies underneath when both cover the same face. It moves only these two relative to each other and never against the other material families; it is a uniform, so switching it compiles nothing.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracksdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onCracks family master: hairline, branching, network, chipped and deep fractures worn into eligible static world walls and floors. It is damage in the existing material, not black lines drawn on top, and it never changes collision or gameplay. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_alphadefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Overall blend of the damage into the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: the family stops sampling entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_branchingdefault 0.50 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly secondary branches grow off the primary crack. It does not add new independent systems.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_cavity_darknessdefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00How dark the inside of the cavity becomes. It only dims the already lit substrate, never paints flat black and never emits light or bloom; at 0 the relief and the chipped rim remain.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_chippingdefault 0.30 / range 0.00..1.00Amount of broken and spalled rim around the cracks, with fragments of exposed substrate. It is tied to the crack itself, not a broad dirt overlay.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_densitydefault 0.32 / range 0.00..1.00How much of the surface carries crack systems. Low values leave broad intact areas, which is what keeps damage believable. 0 disables sampling like alpha 0.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_depthdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded cavity and micro-relief response: how deep the damage reads under the scene light. Geometry, collision and depth buffer are never touched.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_edge_softnessdefault 0.20 / range 0.00..1.00Width of the anti-aliased transition at the crack rim. It softens the edge, and at its default it never erases fine hairline cracks.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onDamage eligible floors and gentle slopes. Independent of the wall lane, and floors ignore the wall band controls entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00World size of a damage system. Small = many small local systems; large = few sweeping fractures. It never changes the line width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto / 1..6 fixed profileDamage appearance. 0 = Auto: broad stable world regions choose the profile and at most two neighbouring profiles meet in a soft boundary. 1 hairline cracks; 2 branching structural; 3 dry crack network; 4 chipped surface; 5 deep fractured; 6 irregular mixed damage. Profiles differ in centreline topology, branch angles, gap scale and rim geometry, not only in threshold or colour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_distributiondefault 0 / 0=uniform, 1=bottom-up bandHow damage is spread over a wall. 0 = uniform over the whole surface. 1 = a bottom-up band, as if the wall is worn from its base. Floors are unaffected by this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_fadedefault 0.18 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the damage-band boundary. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_heightdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00How far the damage band reaches up the wall. Ignored when the distribution is uniform.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onDamage eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_widthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..2.00Width of the crack around its own centreline. It expands or contracts the same cracks without changing where they run or how they branch.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlersdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onWildlife family master: insects, tadpoles, snails and Snakes living on eligible static world surfaces along stable world routes. A local visual layer only - it never changes server gameplay, networking, demos or map files. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_alphadefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly the creatures show over the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: no route maths and no texture samples.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_fliesdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onPositional buzzing around Snake remains after corpse flies arrive. Different carcasses use independent voices and sound variants.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_flies_volumedefault 0.42 / range 0.00..1.00Corpse-fly buzz volume before the global AVFX audio volume.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_hissdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onPositional Snake hiss. A one-shot starts only when a Snake opens its mouth and shoots its tongue. Independent Snakes may hiss at the same time.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_hiss_volumedefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Snake hiss volume before the global AVFX audio volume.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blooddefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onSpread local visual blood from a Snake cut point over its supporting surface or puddle.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_alphadefault 0.82 / range 0.00..1.00Peak opacity of Snake blood.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_persistencedefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Lifetime multiplier for Snake blood.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_sizedefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Final blood spread size; puddles use a wider contour-clipped film.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_spread_speeddefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Speed at which blood expands from the cut point.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_clusteringdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How much the creatures gather into local groups instead of spreading evenly. It shifts group density smoothly and never makes them blink in and out.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_color_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How much individual creatures differ in colour. At 0 every creature of a species shares one tone; higher values spread their tone so a wall is not a row of identical clones. The spread is stable per creature, so one crawler keeps its colour for its whole life.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_lavadefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet lava destroy local decorative wildlife. This is cosmetic and does not affect server gameplay.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_lightningdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet AVFX lightning strikes destroy nearby local decorative wildlife.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_meteorsdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet falling meteor impacts destroy nearby local decorative wildlife.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_weaponsdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet local weapon impacts destroy wildlife. The affected area follows weapon power. No server damage, score or networking is changed.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contrastdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00How hard the creatures read against the surface they walk on. Higher darkens the body and lifts its outline, so they stay clearly visible on bright floors and dark walls alike, and deepens the contact shadow so they sit on the surface instead of looking painted into it.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_densitydefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How many routes are occupied. Raising it adds routes; lowering it removes routes without moving the ones that remain. 0 is a real no-op.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onLet wildlife move on eligible floors and up-slopes. Independent of the wall lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_gait_motiondefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00How much the legs and body move while walking. It changes the gait only, not the travel speed; 0 keeps the legs still while the creature still travels.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_grass_interactiondefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onGrass parts around a Snake body and recovers after it passes.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_grass_radiusdefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Radius of Snake interaction with grass.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_grass_recoverydefault 1.25 / range 0.10..5.00Seconds for grass bent by a Snake to recover.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_grass_strengthdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..3.00Strength of grass bending caused by Snakes.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_populationdefault 1 / range 1..100Peak number of creatures. It multiplies how many can appear per unit of surface, so 100 gives one hundred times the count of 1. Density then thins that peak; the two controls are independent. Bodies are capped to the route spacing, so a very high population naturally means smaller creatures.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wakedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onSnake bodies disturb visible AVFX puddles and leave a fading wake. The wake is clipped to the selected puddle contour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_alphadefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00Opacity of Snake-made puddle waves, independent of wave geometry.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_fadedefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Lifetime of Snake-made water disturbance.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Visibility of Snake-made puddle waves.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_thicknessdefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Thickness of the paired wave bands following the real Snake body path.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_traildefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Length of the fading wake behind a moving Snake.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_puddle_wake_widthdefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Width of water disturbance around a Snake body.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_route_wanderdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00How curved and varied the routes are. It reshapes the same routes smoothly and never moves a creature to a different place.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Physical size of the creatures. It changes how big they are, not how many there are or where their routes run.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_size_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How much individual creatures differ in size. Stable per creature and independent of the overall size control.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_speeddefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00How fast the creatures travel along their routes. 0 freezes them exactly where they are without switching the family off; restoring speed continues from that point.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_tint_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier over the creature colour (1 = neutral).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_tint_gdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier over the creature colour (1 = neutral).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_tint_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier over the creature colour (1 = neutral).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto, 1=random (all species), 2=ants, 3=beetles, 4=spiders, 5=roaches, 6=tiny mixed insects, 7=sparse mixed routes, 8=tadpoles, 9=snails, 10=large snakesWhich creatures appear. Auto uses broad world regions; Random mixes all species. Tadpoles keep the former short profile. Large Snakes use a separate floor, ramp and stair lattice, varied colours, scales and an occasional forked tongue. Live, no restart.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_wall_distributiondefault 0 / 0=uniform, 1=bottom-up bandHow creatures are spread up a wall: evenly, or concentrated in a band rising from the floor. Floors are always even.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_wall_fadedefault 0.18 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the band boundary. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_wall_heightdefault 0.75 / range 0.00..1.00In bottom-up mode, how high up the wall the creatures reach on average (0 floor, 1 ceiling).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onLet wildlife move on eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_debugdefault 0 / 0=off / 1..35 documented modes (diagnostic, current session only)Surface materials diagnostic overlay. 0 = off (no diagnostic work). 1 class (inactive black, wall blue, floor green); 2 face-id hash colour; 3 wall-height grayscale (floors black); 4 coverage field; 5 final mold mask; 6 asset layer + distance LOD; 7 wall-runoff spawn/cell field; 8 moving droplet+trail mask; 9 persistent wetness mask; 10 resolved runoff profile / Auto transition; 11 final composed runoff amount; 12 greenery world-space growth field; 13 greenery profile / Auto regions; 14 greenery island and gap mask; 15 greenery root and leaf motion weights; 16 greenery normal/height/roughness response; 17 final composed greenery amount; 18 cracks world-space system field; 19 selected cracks profile / Auto regions; 20 centreline and secondary branches; 21 cavity, rim and chipped mask; 22 cracks normal/depth/roughness response; 23 final composed cracks amount; 24 brick coverage mask; 25 selected brick profile / Auto regions; 26 brick face-versus-joint lattice; 27 analytic brick height; 28 brick tangent normal; 29 parallax steps actually taken; 30 crawler route occupancy over the candidate cells; 31 stable route id; 32 curve distance to the winning route; 33 selected creature species; 34 gait phase and frame interpolation; 35 final crawler silhouette and contact mask. Off by default and never saved to a preset.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_distancedefault 4096 / range 512..16384Smooth detail LOD distance in world units. Colonies keep their world-anchored identity at any distance; only fine detail fades out smoothly beyond this range, and no colony pops on camera movement.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawingdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onShow your own drawings on world surfaces. Drawings are local, are stored separately for each mod and each map revision, are never sent to a server and are never deleted by a reset or by a preset. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_ceilings0=no ceiling drawings / 1=ceilings receive drawings (default)Let the Drawing surface-material family place its art on ceiling faces as well as the other receiver lanes. Ceilings are the least visible lane, so turning it off is a cheap way to cut drawing coverage without changing the look at eye level. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_surface_materials 1 + cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing 1.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_alphadefault 0.92 / range 0.20..1.00Opacity of the drawing editor toolbox. Affects the overlay only.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_heightdefault 330 / range 200..900Toolbox height in window pixels.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.50..4.00Size of the drawing editor toolbox. Affects the overlay only.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_widthdefault 260 / range 160..640Toolbox width in window pixels.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_xdefault -1 / -1 = default placementToolbox position in window pixels. -1 keeps the default placement.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_ydefault -1 / -1 = default placementToolbox position in window pixels. -1 keeps the default placement.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onShow and allow drawing on eligible floors and up-slopes. Turning the lane off hides those drawings; it never deletes them.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onShow and allow drawing on eligible walls and ceilings. Turning the lane off hides those drawings; it never deletes them.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfacesdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onMaster for this Surface Coverings layer. It needs the Surface Materials master and at least one receiver lane. The layer name only selects its catalog and its default lane; it never restricts geometry. Default off.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_alphadefault 0.82 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly an accepted covering blends over the original BSP material. 0 is a real no-op: the layer stops before any hash, noise, texture, relief or motion work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_cavitydefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Darkening inside the material's own hollows. Contact shading of the relief, never invented emission.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_ceilingsdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible ceilings and undersides. Ceilings are a lane of their own: switching it on does not change any other material family.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_coveragedefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00Area of the coverage field — WHERE the covering exists, which is independent of alpha. 0 is a real no-op.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_coverage_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the covered/uncovered boundary only. It never changes the material's own grain or motif.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_depthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded parallax depth. The offset is clamped and fades out at grazing angles and at distance, so it never smears or samples past a face edge.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distributiondefault 1 / 0=Uniform, 1=Natural islands, 2=Clustered, 3=Bottom-up, 4=Top-down, 5=Directional bands, 6=Slope-biasedHow the coverage field is laid out over the world. The mode changes what reach, softness and direction mean, but not their stored value.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_directiondefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesDirection the banded and gradient distribution modes follow. Ignored by the modes that have no direction.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_reachdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Zone or bias of the distribution mode: the band reach for bottom-up and top-down, and the slope bias for the slope mode.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00Size of the macro field the distribution mode works with. Small = many small areas; large = a few broad ones.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the distribution mode's own boundary. Independent of the coverage-edge softness.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible floors and gentle up-slopes.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_materialdefault 1 / 1..128 stable catalog idStable Material Recipe id from this layer's 128-entry catalog. Pick it through the material picker: every entry is derived from one exact reference photograph, so the id also identifies the source. Changing it is a uniform change — nothing reloads and no shader is compiled.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_directiondefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesDirection of drift and ripple motion. Swirl and pulse use it as a bias.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_modedefault 0 / 0=Off, 1=Drift, 2=Ripple, 3=Swirl, 4=PulseShader-only motion of this layer, off by default. It is world-anchored, so it does not swim with the camera and a mirror shows the same phase as the direct view. The two layers move independently.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00Spatial frequency of the motion field: small = long slow waves, large = fine busy movement.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_speeddefault 1 / range 0.00..4.00Speed of this layer's motion. The module owns one clock; this multiplies it, which is what makes the two layers independent.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_strengthdefault 0 / range 0.00..2.00Motion amplitude. Exactly 0 is a real no-motion path, not a slow animation.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_turbulencedefault 0.30 / range 0.00..1.00How non-linear the motion field is. 0 is a clean regular movement; 1 is broken and irregular.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_reliefdefault 0.60 / range 0.00..1.00Strength of the bump and normal response. It changes how the surface catches light; BSP vertices, collision, silhouette and depth are never touched.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_rotationdefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesRotation of the material within the surface plane. It is anchored to the BSP plane, so it does not turn with the camera.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_roughnessdefault 1 / range 0.00..2.00Private material response of this layer: low values read as damp or polished, high values as dry and matte.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00User multiplier on the recipe's own physical scale. 1 keeps the size the reference photograph implies.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_stretchdefault 1 / range 0.25..4.00Anisotropic stretch of the material along the surface. 1 is square.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_bdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_gdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_rdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral: the recipe's own palette is used unchanged.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_wallsdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible walls and steep faces.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenerydefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onGreenery family master: moss, lichen, ivy, leafy creep and small weeds grown over eligible static world surfaces. This is a shader coating on the original texture, not the separate 3D grass and not a green tint. Off by default; with it off the family does no work at all.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_alphadefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Blend strength of the greenery over the original surface. 0 = invisible, 1 = the growth fully replaces the substrate colour where it is present.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_coveragedefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Occupied fraction of the eligible surface. Below one the growth always leaves irregular holes with the original texture visible through them.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_coverage_softnessdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00Softness of the island edges. Small = crisp defined borders; large = a gradual organic fade into the bare surface.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_damp_biasdefault 0.50 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly growth prefers low and damp places. At 0 it has no effect and growth is distributed evenly. When wall runoff is on, its already-composed wetness restrainedly adds to this preference; greenery never turns runoff on and works fully without it.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onGrow greenery on eligible floor and gentle-slope surfaces. Independent of the wall lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_foliage_motiondefault 0.35 / range 0.00..2.00Restrained movement of leaf and vine tips. Roots stay anchored: the displacement is zero at the attachment and small at the tips. The moss and lichen profiles are static and never pretend to wave; at 0 every profile is completely still.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00World-space size of the growth features. Small = fine dense detail; large = broad sweeping colonies. Purely spatial: it never changes the profile or the coverage fraction.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_thicknessdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00Strength of the micro-relief: how much the growth reads as raised cushions under the scene light. Bounded shading only — geometry, collision and depth are never changed.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_tint_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier applied on top of the profile's own palette. 1 = neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_tint_gdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier applied on top of the profile's own palette. 1 = neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_tint_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier applied on top of the profile's own palette. 1 = neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto / 1..6 fixed profileGrowth appearance. 0 = Auto: broad stable world regions choose the profile and at most two neighbouring profiles meet in a soft boundary. 1 soft moss film; 2 lichen mottling; 3 ivy and vines; 4 leafy creep; 5 weeds and ferns; 6 damp overgrowth. Profiles differ in island structure, edge character, relief and whether foliage moves — not only in colour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_wall_distributiondefault 1 / 0=uniform, 1=natural bandHow growth is distributed over a wall. 0 = uniform over the whole surface. 1 = a natural band: moss, weeds and damp overgrowth climb upward from the low damp end, while ivy and leafy creep hang downward from the upper attachment. In Auto the direction follows the chosen profile.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_wall_fadedefault 0.15 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the growth-band boundary. Small = a sharper edge; large = a soft gradient. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_wall_heightdefault 0.60 / range 0.00..1.00How far the growth band reaches along the wall in natural-band mode. Small = a narrow strip near the attachment; large = growth over most of the wall. Ignored when the distribution is uniform.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_greenery_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onGrow greenery on eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane: turning floors off never changes walls.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold0=off (default) / 1=onMold family master. With the subsystem master and at least one of walls/floors on, irregular mold colonies grow over eligible static walls and floors. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_alphadefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00Blend strength of mold over the original texture. 0 is a real no-op (the wall is unchanged); 1 is fully opaque mold. The original texture stays recognizable at partial alpha.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_coveragedefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Irregular occupied fraction — how much of a surface the colonies cover, keeping holes and local variation so the wall never turns uniformly green.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_coverage_softnessdefault 0.5 / range 0.00..1.00Coverage softness — width of the fade from covered to uncovered. Higher values ease the alpha down gradually near colony edges for a natural look; lower values give crisp, peeled-plaster boundaries.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off 1=onAllow mold on eligible floor / up-slope faces (topology effective normal Z >= 0.35). On by default. Downward ceilings and undersides are never coated.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_scaledefault 1.0 / range 0.25..4.00Colony scale. Smaller values give finer, denser colonies; larger values give broader patches. Anchored in world space, so the pattern does not swim with the camera.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_tint_bdefault 1.0 / range 0.00..3.00Blue-channel tint multiplier over the selected profile colour (1 = neutral).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_tint_gdefault 1.0 / range 0.00..3.00Green-channel tint multiplier over the selected profile colour (1 = neutral).
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_tint_rdefault 1.0 / range 0.00..3.00Red-channel tint multiplier applied over the selected profile colour (1 = neutral). Raise/lower R/G/B together to push the mold toward any hue — including blue or red the base palettes do not have. Same idea as the sun/moon colour cvars.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_variantdefault 0 / integer 0..8Mold appearance profile. 0 = Auto (blends broad world-space regions of every look with soft transitions); 1..8 select one fixed look: 1 current mixed, 2 soft green wash, 3 damp dark, 4 black spotting, 5 grey powdery, 6 white fuzzy, 7 olive fibrous, 8 aged brown-green. Live uniform-only change, no restart or rebuild.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_wall_distributiondefault 1 / 0 uniform, 1 bottom-upVertical distribution on walls. 0 = uniform over the whole wall; 1 = bottom-up, biased toward damp-looking low areas while keeping holes and variation. Floors always use uniform.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_wall_fadedefault 0.15 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth transition width of the bottom-up height limit. Small = a sharper band; large = a soft gradient. Never a hard horizontal cut.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_wall_heightdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00In bottom-up mode, the normalized height (0 = wall base, 1 = top of the connected wall group) up to which mold reaches on average.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_mold_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off 1=onAllow mold on eligible wall / steep faces (topology effective normal Z between -0.35 and 0.35). On by default. Class comes from the original BSP surface, never from tessellated micro-relief.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_qualitydefault 2 / 0 Performance, 1 Balanced, 2 High, 3 UltraSurface detail and runtime wildlife quality, changed live without a shader recompile. Material work is 1/2/3/4 sample sites for Performance/Balanced/High/Ultra. Redirected carcass-feeder pools are 16/48/128/256 globally and 4/12/32/64 per carcass; fly swarms are 12/24/40/80. Snake wake, blood, snow and grass-reaction budgets scale through the same tier. Correctness queues for weapon contacts and audio are never reduced by quality.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_seeddefault 1337 / integer 0..16777215Global pattern seed, mixed in the shader with each map's immutable per-group seed. Changing it gives a different colony layout live, without rebuilding metadata or topology.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfacesdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onMaster for this Surface Coverings layer. It needs the Surface Materials master and at least one receiver lane. The layer name only selects its catalog and its default lane; it never restricts geometry. Default off.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_alphadefault 0.82 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly an accepted covering blends over the original BSP material. 0 is a real no-op: the layer stops before any hash, noise, texture, relief or motion work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_cavitydefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Darkening inside the material's own hollows. Contact shading of the relief, never invented emission.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_ceilingsdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible ceilings and undersides. Ceilings are a lane of their own: switching it on does not change any other material family.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_coveragedefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00Area of the coverage field — WHERE the covering exists, which is independent of alpha. 0 is a real no-op.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_coverage_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the covered/uncovered boundary only. It never changes the material's own grain or motif.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_depthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded parallax depth. The offset is clamped and fades out at grazing angles and at distance, so it never smears or samples past a face edge.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_distributiondefault 1 / 0=Uniform, 1=Natural islands, 2=Clustered, 3=Bottom-up, 4=Top-down, 5=Directional bands, 6=Slope-biasedHow the coverage field is laid out over the world. The mode changes what reach, softness and direction mean, but not their stored value.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_distribution_directiondefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesDirection the banded and gradient distribution modes follow. Ignored by the modes that have no direction.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_distribution_reachdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Zone or bias of the distribution mode: the band reach for bottom-up and top-down, and the slope bias for the slope mode.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_distribution_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00Size of the macro field the distribution mode works with. Small = many small areas; large = a few broad ones.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_distribution_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the distribution mode's own boundary. Independent of the coverage-edge softness.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_floorsdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible floors and gentle up-slopes.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_materialdefault 1 / 1..128 stable catalog idStable Material Recipe id from this layer's 128-entry catalog. Pick it through the material picker: every entry is derived from one exact reference photograph, so the id also identifies the source. Changing it is a uniform change — nothing reloads and no shader is compiled.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_directiondefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesDirection of drift and ripple motion. Swirl and pulse use it as a bias.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_modedefault 0 / 0=Off, 1=Drift, 2=Ripple, 3=Swirl, 4=PulseShader-only motion of this layer, off by default. It is world-anchored, so it does not swim with the camera and a mirror shows the same phase as the direct view. The two layers move independently.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00Spatial frequency of the motion field: small = long slow waves, large = fine busy movement.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_speeddefault 1 / range 0.00..4.00Speed of this layer's motion. The module owns one clock; this multiplies it, which is what makes the two layers independent.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_strengthdefault 0 / range 0.00..2.00Motion amplitude. Exactly 0 is a real no-motion path, not a slow animation.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_motion_turbulencedefault 0.30 / range 0.00..1.00How non-linear the motion field is. 0 is a clean regular movement; 1 is broken and irregular.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_reliefdefault 0.60 / range 0.00..1.00Strength of the bump and normal response. It changes how the surface catches light; BSP vertices, collision, silhouette and depth are never touched.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_rotationdefault 0 / range -180..180 degreesRotation of the material within the surface plane. It is anchored to the BSP plane, so it does not turn with the camera.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_roughnessdefault 1 / range 0.00..2.00Private material response of this layer: low values read as damp or polished, high values as dry and matte.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_scaledefault 1 / range 0.125..8.00User multiplier on the recipe's own physical scale. 1 keeps the size the reference photograph implies.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_stretchdefault 1 / range 0.25..4.00Anisotropic stretch of the material along the surface. 1 is square.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_tint_bdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_tint_gdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_tint_rdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral: the recipe's own palette is used unchanged.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_surfaces_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onAllow this layer on eligible walls and steep faces.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water0=off (default) / 1=onWall runoff family master (Стекание воды). With the subsystem master on, animated water droplets, beads, rivulets and wet sheen run down eligible static WALLS only — floors are never affected. Off by default. Water darkens/glosses the wall but adds no light and no bloom.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_alphadefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Blend strength of the runoff over the original wall. 0 is a real no-op; 1 is the strongest wet look. The wall texture and lightmap stay recognizable at partial alpha.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_coveragedefault 0.40 / range 0.00..1.00Irregular occupied fraction — how much of a wall the water paths cover, keeping dry gaps and local variation so it never looks like a uniform sheet.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_distributiondefault 0 / 0 uniform, 1 top-fedVertical distribution on walls. 0 = uniform sources over the whole wall; 1 = top-fed, sources biased to the top and limited downward by wall reach. Walls only.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_droplet_balancedefault 0.50 / range 0.00..1.00Balance between discrete droplets and continuous streams. 0 = mostly separate droplets; 1 = mostly continuous streams; in between mixes both.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Bead / stream scale. Smaller values give finer, denser beads; larger values give broader streams. Anchored in world space, so the pattern does not swim with the camera.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_speeddefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Flow speed of the descending beads. Changing it live alters velocity smoothly without teleporting existing beads. Anchored to a single per-frame flow clock shared by every reflection.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_trail_lengthdefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Length of the damp trail left behind each moving bead. Smaller = short faint tails; larger = long persistent tracks.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_variantdefault 0 / integer 0..6Runoff appearance profile. 0 = Auto (blends broad world-space regions of neighbouring looks); 1..6 select one fixed look: 1 fine droplets, 2 bead trails, 3 thin slow rivulets, 4 heavy streams, 5 broad wet film, 6 intermittent mixed runoff. Live uniform-only change, no restart or rebuild.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_wall_fadedefault 0.15 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth transition width of the top-fed reach boundary. Small = a sharper band; large = a soft gradient.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_wall_reachdefault 0.75 / range 0.00..1.00In top-fed mode, the normalized downward reach (0 = only the top, 1 = down to the wall base) that water travels on average. The lower boundary is broken by world noise, never a hard horizontal cut.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_wetnessdefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00Damp / gloss response. Higher values darken and gloss the wet areas more strongly (a wetter look); lower values keep a restrained damp trace. Never emits light or bloom.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for experimental AVFX Mirror Surfaces. Selected static world surfaces (floors/slopes and/or walls) reflect the scene like a mirror. Use at your own risk; enabling wall and floor mirrors together is not recommended. The saved choice is effective only in deathmatch 0, on a local deathmatch 1 server, or during dm2/mvd2 Demo Player playback. Remote deathmatch 1 is hard-blocked from authoritative server status and cannot be enabled through cl_avfx_multiplayer or another user cvar. This restriction applies only to mirror floors/walls, never to puddle or BSP-water reflections. Mirror floors/slopes temporarily suppress AVFX puddles and snow cover; wall-only mirrors remain compatible with puddles and snow cover. Rain, snowfall and BSP water keep working. Off by default (opt-in); independent of the weather preset. On capable WGL, mirror receivers inherit the same BSP tessellation as the world automatically; on EGL they use ordinary flat geometry.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_debugdefault 0 / 0=off / 1..10 documented internal modes (diagnostic, current session only)Mirror surfaces diagnostic overlay for tuning and troubleshooting. 0 = off (default). Higher values colour receiver classes and connected groups, isolate a single active plane, show the exact polygon mask, SSR confidence, planar fallback, reflected depth and the effective-state summary. Off by default and never saved to a preset.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_distancedefault 4096 / range 256..16384 wu / step 64Maximum distance (world units) at which a mirror receiver is selected and captured. Farther surfaces are skipped to save cost. 4096 by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_floor_slope_maxdefault 65 / range 0..89 degrees / step 1Angle limit (degrees from horizontal) that separates floors/slopes from walls. A surface tilted up to this angle counts as a floor/slope; steeper counts as a wall. 0 mirrors only near-horizontal floors; 65 (default) includes normal ramps and stairs; near 89 still never turns a ceiling into a floor. Changing it re-filters receivers without rebuilding the surface inventory.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off 1=onTurn floors and up-facing slopes (stairs, ramps, upward tilts up to the angle limit) into mirrors. While active, this category suppresses AVFX puddles on the same floor/slope receiver domain. On by default so enabling the master immediately shows a visible floor mirror. Uses the original BSP surface class, so a tessellated floor is never reclassified from its micro-relief.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflectiondefault 0 / 0=off 1=onMaster toggle for reflecting alias models (players, monsters, weapons, items, sky objects) in mirror surfaces. Off by default. Each model category below has its own independent toggle on top of this parent; with the parent on and a category on, matching models are reflected with correct depth/occlusion so hidden geometry does not show through walls.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_actorsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect players and monsters in mirror surfaces, including your own body in first person through a mirror-only body feed (the on-screen first-person view is never affected). Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_armordefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect armor pickup models in mirror surfaces. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_cometsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect AVFX comets in mirror surfaces, blocked by reflected roofs/walls. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_itemsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect generic item and object models in mirror surfaces. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_meteorsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect AVFX meteors in mirror surfaces, blocked by reflected roofs/walls. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_planetsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect Earth, Moon, Sun and compatible celestial bodies in mirror surfaces, obeying reflected BSP line-of-sight so a body does not show through a roof or wall. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_projectilesdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect final presented projectiles and the rail beam in mirror surfaces, including synchronized local prediction. Requires the model-reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_shipsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect AVFX sky ships in mirror surfaces. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_strengthdefault 0.80 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Strength of reflected models in mirror surfaces. 1.0 is a full-strength reflection; lower values fade the reflected models. 0.80 by default. Independent of the scene reflection strength.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_surface_volumesdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect placed Surface Volumes (steam, smoke and fog) in mirror surfaces. Requires the model-reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_model_reflection_weaponsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onReflect world, pickup and linked weapon models in mirror surfaces — NOT the first-person view gun. Requires the model reflection parent. Off by default.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_roughnessdefault 0.00 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Mirror surface roughness. 0.00 (default) is a sharp rigid mirror. Higher values soften/blur the reflection. This is a rigid optical roughness; it is unrelated to and unaffected by the liquid ripple/distortion sliders of puddles and water.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_scene_reflectiondefault 1 / 0=off 1=onEnable reflection of static world detail in mirror surfaces. On by default. Medium and High keep persistent planar capture slots while their selected planes remain visible. Ultra captures every visible canonical plane immediately, so a model reflection cannot require camera movement to appear. Planes over a lower-profile budget use SSR, with a neutral source-colour fallback for unresolved pixels.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_scene_reflection_qualitydefault 2 / 0=Performance 1=Medium 2=Quality(8) 3=Ultra(16) 4=Extra(all)Reflection quality profile. 0 = Performance (SSR only), 1 = Medium (one persistent planar capture), 2 = Quality (up to 8 persistent planar capture slots, default), 3 = Ultra (up to 16 slots), 4 = Extra (every visible canonical plane, no capture-count limit). Bounded profiles keep stable slots and use SSR with a neutral source-colour fallback over budget. Extra is the maximum-quality mode: every selected receiver receives its complete reflected scene from the first frame. This never changes BSP tessellation quality or receiver shape.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_scene_reflection_strengthdefault 0.90 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Strength of the reflected scene in mirror surfaces. 1.0 is a full bright mirror; lower values dim the reflection toward the surface's own colour. 0.90 by default for a strong but not overpowering mirror.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_surface_objectsdefault 1 / 0=off 1=onReflect the already enabled world Grass (Surface Objects) inside mirror captures, with its current geometry, density, wind phase and lighting. On by default, but has work only when Grass itself is enabled — it does NOT turn Grass on. Uses the existing world-anchored blades with no reseeding or density change; the Performance quality profile may skip it and reports that clamp.
cl_avfx_surface_mirror_wallsdefault 0 / 0=off 1=onTurn vertical and steep wall-like surfaces into mirrors. Wall-only mirrors remain compatible with AVFX puddles on floors. Off by default because wall mirrors capture a wider scene and cost more than floors. A wall mirror reflects players, monsters, weapons and items standing away from it, upright and correctly left-right mirrored.
cl_avfx_surface_objects0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX Surface Objects — decorative objects placed directly on eligible world surfaces. Independent of the rain/snow/mist weather profiles and of cl_avfx_preset, so surface decoration can run with any weather setting or none. Off by default (opt-in); client-side visual only with no gameplay effect. Individual object families such as grass keep their own sub-toggle on top of this master.
cl_avfx_surface_volumesdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onMaster for AVFX Surface Volumes: volumetric steam and smoke rising from areas you mark on floors, walls, ceilings and slopes. Needs cl_avfx on. Turning it on shows the marked areas in the current map immediately, with no map reload and no video restart.
cl_avfx_surface_volumes_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=coverage tint / session only (diagnostic, current session only)Session-only diagnostic: tints the volume by its accumulated coverage so overdraw is visible. Never read from a config and never written by any config or preset writer; after a restart it is off again.
cl_avfx_surface_volumes_gpu_budget_msdefault 0.75 / range 0.10..4.00 (legacy preset scale)Calibrated density control for EACH visible volume shape. The legacy 0.10..4.00 numerical scale is retained for preset compatibility; the cvar name is retained for ABI compatibility. The value is NOT measured GPU milliseconds and is NOT a whole-pass GPU ceiling. Adding a shape never changes existing shapes; total GPU load grows with the visible shape count.
cl_avfx_surface_volumes_loddefault 0 / 0=off, 1=near, 2=medium, 3=farDistance visibility of whole marked areas. 0 shows every area; 1..3 show only areas within a growing distance of the camera. A visible area always draws WHOLE and fades out completely at its cutoff.
cl_avfx_surface_volumes_max_lobesdefault 1400 / range 64..8192Upper bound on volume primitives built for EACH shape. This population is independent and is never divided between shapes.
cl_avfx_surface_volumes_qualitydefault 2 / 0=Low, 1=Balanced, 2=High, 3=UltraVolume detail: how many samples each covered pixel integrates and how much screen coverage the pass may use. One shader serves every tier, so changing this compiles nothing.
cl_avfx_volclouds0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX volumetric clouds. When ON, the sky shader runs a GPU raymarch through a world-space horizontal cloud layer ([base_height, base_height+thickness]) and composites cloud color over the base sky behind world geometry. Reacts to sun, moon, storm darkening, and optionally attenuates the sun/moon disk/corona via _sun_occlusion. Default OFF — opt-in; new visual layer adds GPU cost only when enabled. Disabled state is a single uniform check.
cl_avfx_volclouds_adaptive1=fixed step (default) / 2..4=progressively coarser empty-space skippingStep mode of the volumetric-cloud raymarcher. 1 keeps the tuned fixed-step march. Values above 1 coarsely skip space the marcher can prove is empty, which buys frame rate on cloudy skies at the cost of slightly blockier cloud edges. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1.
cl_avfx_volclouds_ambientdefault 0.50 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Ambient light floor for clouds (warm-blue sky-scattered light). 0 = no ambient (clouds pitch black when no direct light reaches them); 0.50 (default) = balanced night readability without washing out the sky; 1.0 = strong full ambient (clouds bright even at night).
cl_avfx_volclouds_base_heightdefault 7648 / range 0..8192 wu / step 16World-space Z (height) where the cloud layer begins. 7648 (default) puts the bottom of the cloud layer well above typical playable areas in stock Q2 maps. Lower values pull clouds closer to the play area; higher values push them further into the sky. The slab from base_height to base_height + thickness is what the raymarch intersects.
cl_avfx_volclouds_countdefault 177 / range 1..256 / step 1Procedural macro-cell / cluster density. Higher values produce more cloud cells across the sky; lower values give fewer larger clusters. Affects the perceived cloud cell granularity — combined with size it determines roughly how many cloud puffs fill a typical view. This is NOT a CPU object count; it is a shader-side parameter controlling the macro noise.
cl_avfx_volclouds_coveragedefault 0.65 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Sky coverage / fill amount. 0 = scattered wisps only (high threshold on macro noise); 0.65 (default) = moderate broken-cloud cover; 1 = full overcast (low threshold, nearly everything passes the macro gate). Combined with density and opacity for final cloud presence on screen.
cl_avfx_volclouds_debugdefault 0 / values 0,1,2,3 (diagnostic, current session only)Debug visualisation mode for the volclouds raymarch. 0 = off (normal composite — default). 1 = density: visualise accumulated 1 - transmittance. 2 = lighting: visualise raw inscatter color (cloud lighting without scene composite). 3 = steps: visualise horizon fade ramp (0 at horizon, 1 at zenith). Use for screenshots and tuning; should be 0 in normal play.
cl_avfx_volclouds_densitydefault 1.4 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Base cloud density (extinction coefficient per ray-step before height profile). 1.4 (default) gives readable clouds with daylight transmittance through gaps. Higher values produce thick opaque clouds; lower values give thin wispy clouds. Multiplied with height profile + macro coverage along the raymarch via Beer absorption.
cl_avfx_volclouds_detail_scaledefault 0.30 / range 0.05..8 / step 0.05Detail / erosion noise spatial scale (subtracted from macro to break up cloud edges). 0.30 (default) gives soft large-scale edge detail. Higher values produce finer cloud edge detail; lower values produce smoother edges.
cl_avfx_volclouds_erosiondefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Strength of edge erosion: how strongly the detail noise eats away at cloud edges. 0 = no erosion (clouds have smooth blob edges); 0.35 (default) = natural ragged edges; 1.0 = aggressive erosion (clouds look fragmented).
cl_avfx_volclouds_evolution_speeddefault 4.15 / range 0..5 / step 0.05Speed of internal noise-field evolution (cloud SHAPES morphing over time, independent from translation by wind). Range 0..5. 0 freezes the noise field entirely (combine with a non-zero seed for reproducible screenshots / A-B comparison). 4.15 (default) = fast visible morphing. 5 = maximum (rapid roiling storm clouds).
cl_avfx_volclouds_fluffinessdefault 0.55 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Boost of inscattered light visibility. 0 = flat shading (clouds read as solid colored blobs); 0.55 (default) = fluffy cumulus look with visible inscatter; 1.0 = maximum boost (bright glowing puffs).
cl_avfx_volclouds_horizon_fadedefault 0.2 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Horizon-band fade. Controls how strongly cloud contribution attenuates as the per-pixel sky ray approaches the horizon. 0 = clouds fully visible at the horizon (can look unnatural); 0.2 (default) = clouds fade out smoothly near horizon (matches the real-world look where distant clouds dim into atmospheric haze); 1 = clouds visible only well above horizon.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_coverage0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.7)Sky coverage for layer 1. Higher = more cloud and smaller blue gaps. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds_layers 1 (Upper sky model), the layer index below cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count, and cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_enable 1. The value is applied relative to the global cloud settings, not as an absolute.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_density0..2 (menu step 0.05, default 0.95)Cloud-body density for layer 1. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds_layers 1 (Upper sky model), the layer index below cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count, and cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_enable 1. The value is applied relative to the global cloud settings, not as an absolute.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_detail0.1..4 (menu step 0.05, default 1); engine accepts 0.05..8Detail and erosion noise scale for layer 1. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds_layers 1 (Upper sky model), the layer index below cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count, and cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_enable 1. The value is applied relative to the global cloud settings, not as an absolute.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_enable0=Off / 1=On (default 1)Enable layer 1: low heavy cumulus. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds_layers 1 (Upper sky model) and the layer index below cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count. Each active layer adds raymarch work.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_erosion0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.3)Edge erosion strength for layer 1. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds_layers 1 (Upper sky model), the layer index below cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count, and cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_enable 1. The value is applied relative to the global cloud settings, not as an absolute.
cl_avfx_volclouds_l1_evolution_speed0..2 (menu step 0.05, default 0.2); engine accepts 0..5Shape evolution speed for layer 1. cl_avfx_volclouds_l3_wind_speed0..5 (menu step 0.05, default 1.9); engine accepts 0..8Wind drift speed for layer 3. The value is applied relative to the global cloud settings, not as an absolute.
cl_avfx_volclouds_layer_count1..3 (menu step 1, default 3)Number of active layers in Upper sky mode. Ignored by Full sphere mode. Range 1..3. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1. More active layers mean more raymarching, so this is a direct performance knob.
cl_avfx_volclouds_layers0=Full sphere (single field) / 1=Upper sky (layered) (default 1)Sky coverage and cloud model. Full sphere uses one mirrored field above and below the horizon. Upper sky uses the layered model only above the horizon. Default: Upper sky. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_volclouds 1. More active layers mean more raymarching, so this is a direct performance knob.
cl_avfx_volclouds_lighting_maskdefault 1 / range 0..1 / step 0.05How strongly volumetric clouds dim sun and moon world/entity lighting. 1.0 (default) = full physical dimming — thick volclouds darken the world. 0.0 = volclouds do not affect scene lighting at all (only god rays + disk occlusion still react). This is independent of cl_avfx_volclouds_sun_occlusion (disk only) and cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_mask (god rays only).
cl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for local lightning illumination of volumetric clouds. When ON (default), nearby lightning strikes brighten the cloud body locally within radius — clouds light up around the strike rather than uniformly across the whole sky. Reuses the same 8-strike origin array as surface lightning but applies volclouds-specific radius / strength / falloff. Sparse-sampled (every 4th raymarch step) so cost is bounded.
cl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_falloffdefault 1.25 / range 0.25..4 / step 0.05Radial/edge softness shaping exponent for the local cloud-entry glow. 1.0 = linear falloff toward the glow's edge; 1.25 (default) = slightly tighter near the glow center with smooth falloff; higher values up to 4.0 = very tight bright core; lower values down to 0.25 = nearly uniform fill inside the glow. After smoothstep shaping for visual softness. This only shapes the radial profile; the vertical extent and the bulb shape are fixed by the bounded-glow geometry.
cl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_radiusdefault 1200 / range 0..8000 / step 50Horizontal radius in world units of the local cloud-entry glow around each visible lightning bolt top. The glow is a bounded 3D volume anchored at the bolt-cloud entry point (not a cone flaring upward) — it has finite vertical extent (clamped via 0.75 × this, 256..900 wu above and 0.2 × this, 96..240 wu below), peaks in a small bulb at the entry, and fades outward and upward. Lower values keep the glow tight around each strike; higher values produce a broader storm flash that may overlap from multiple simultaneous strikes.
cl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_strengthdefault 4 / range 0..5 / step 0.05Brightness boost multiplier for the local cloud-entry glow. 4 (default) gives clearly visible local brightening at the bolt-cloud entry. 0 disables (same as master off). Higher values up to 5.0 produce cinematic over-bright cloud flashes near the strike. Per-strike fade envelope (leader/peak/decay) is preserved from the bolt — this just scales it.
cl_avfx_volclouds_moon_lighting0=off / 1=on (default)When ON (default), the moon's direction + phase contribute weak cold scatter to clouds at night. Much weaker than sun by design. When OFF, clouds get only ambient + sun contribution.
cl_avfx_volclouds_noise_sourcedefault 0 / values 0,1Cloud detail source. 0 = Fast procedural: in-shader hash/value-noise FBM (cheapest, no texture memory, broad compatibility). 1 = Rich 3D noise: generated tileable Perlin-Worley shape + Worley erosion 3D textures (128^3 shape / 64^3 detail, RGBA channels) for connected dense cloud bodies with clean blue gaps — the reference summer-sky look. The 3D textures are generated/uploaded ~once when AVFX clouds need them (gen time and resolution shown in cl_avfx_info under volcloud noise:); nothing is generated when cl_avfx 0 or cl_avfx_volclouds 0.
cl_avfx_volclouds_opacitydefault 0.45 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Final opacity scalar of the cloud composite over base sky. 0.45 (default) lets sky color show through thin cloud edges naturally. 1.0 = clouds fully obscure at max accumulated density; 0 disables visual contribution (use debug modes to inspect).
